notes.title: Halloween update and "Not Your Space"
notes.notes:
In a few days, the Halloween update will come down. If you haven't played it yet, get it now! If you love it, you might want to turn off auto-updates ;)

[img=https://ibol17.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/big-jack.png]

But the big news from Ibology right now is that "Not Your Space" , a customizable sci-fi real time strategy game has just been announced, and is on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/181428952/not-your-space-customizable-sci-fi-real-time-strat]Kickstarter[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=540345893]Greenlight[/url]

[img=https://ibol17.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/desktop-prob-best.png]

It's going to be an awesome game (it's already pretty great). Here is the art style [b]Not Your Space[/b] will have once funded:

[img=https://ibol17.files.wordpress.com/2015/11/ships1_color-steam.png]

[h1]XenoBloom is a wonderful experience of zen growing and strategy, but sometimes you just need to blow up spaceships. [b]NYS[/b] comes to the rescue!

notes.title: XenoBloom gets a ~ S P O O K Y ~ update!
notes.notes:
Get in the Halloween spirit with XenoBloom 1.13

The world has undergone a total overhaul, and 10 new "plants" are available for growing ... 
[b]for a limited time![/b]

Without giving too much away, here is a sneak peak:

[img=https://ibol17.files.wordpress.com/2015/10/something-spooky.png]

To access the new plants, you will need to start a new game, in whichever mode you choose.

Also of note, the new plants will not affect "Ecological Mode".

[h1]Try it now, this won't last forever![/h1]
